llm_fv_evidence.interpretation: Management remarks are secondary-attributed; no new order, wafer shipments or standalone revenue booked. Forecast horizons, capital spending and GF supplier value cannot be converted directly to incremental TSMC FV.
missing_fields: FY2027-FY2029 N2/N3/CoWoS revenue by segment and wafer/package volume
FY2027-FY2029 operating margin, capex, depreciation, tax and operating NWC
Quantified overlap with baseline forecast and mature OOS evidence

qualitative_claims.description: TSMC management says more customers are in discussion for A14 than for N2 and expects A14 to become a larger node; contacts are not firm wafer orders.
Smartphone small dies and AI/HPC large dies ramp on new nodes concurrently; management says learning curve reasonable, but no unit yield or wafer ASP disclosed.
High-NA EUV planned from 2030; management describes 12-inch reticle before 2031 and cost/maturity criteria, not current CAPEX or production.
